# NuraWell platform modules — agent quickstart (generated; do not edit)
> Read AGENTS.md first. Each module has its own llms.txt with API + install + what must NOT change.

- access (@platform/access@0.1.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/access/llms.txt — Product-agnostic admin access policy: justification-gated PII grants, device enrollment tokens, access-log pre-filter and pseudonymisation for AI audit. Pure logic, no I/O.
- ai-engine (@platform/ai-engine@0.1.0, shareable): packages/@platform/ai-engine/llms.txt — Product-agnostic AI engine: provider client (OpenAI-compatible or mock), mandatory privacy guard, cost logging tagged by product and feature. No env reads.
- auth (@platform/auth@0.1.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/auth/llms.txt — Product-agnostic auth helpers: session lookup through an injected adapter, product membership, admin gating. Fails closed. No env reads.
- hooks (@platform/hooks@0.1.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/hooks/llms.txt — WordPress-style actions and filters so modules extend a product without editing its code. Pure logic.
- iam (@platform/iam@0.1.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/iam/llms.txt — Product-agnostic access control for the multi-product console: products, roles, permissions, just-in-time elevation, anti-escalation rules. Pure logic.
- licensing (@platform/licensing@0.3.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/licensing/llms.txt — Module licensing. Default (monthly): AES-GCM sealed bundle unlocked by an Ed25519 license valid until next billing + 3 grace days; free signed static status file polled ~2 min for mid-period block/unblock; fail-closed after 6h unreachable; tamper detection; per-buyer watermark + signed terms acceptance. Optional premium: server-held core gateway (HMAC-signed requests). No remote deletion.
- module-library-ui (@platform/module-library-ui@0.2.0, internal): packages/@platform/module-library-ui/llms.txt — Mac Finder-style ops hub: product sidebar, cross-product overview, module library (icon/list), per-product toggles through IAM, plugin-store module pages, share/sell packages with signed licenses.
- qc (@platform/qc@0.1.0, shareable): packages/@platform/qc/llms.txt — Product-agnostic quality control: a product registers checks, the console runs them isolated with timeouts and shows one screen. Pure logic.
- security-crypto (@platform/security-crypto@0.1.0, shareable, always on): packages/@platform/security-crypto/llms.txt — Per-user envelope field encryption (enc:v2): AES-256-GCM, per-user data keys wrapped by an injected master key, AAD binding to table/column/row, blind indexes for equality search.
- ui (@platform/ui@0.1.0, internal, always on): packages/@platform/ui/llms.txt — Shared design tokens for every product (canonical NuraWell palette and console surfaces). Pure data, no React.

Commands: node scripts/modules/list.mjs | check.mjs | index.mjs | pack.mjs <id> | install.mjs <id> --target <repo> [--dry-run] | verify.mjs
